question: The length of the body diagonal of a cube is 8sqrt{3} cm. What is the volume (in cm³) of the cube?
solution:
Given:

The length of the body diagonal of a cube is 8sqrt{3} cm.

Concept used:

Body diagonal of a cube = ​​sqrt{3}A 

The volume of a cube = A³

(where A is the length of each side)

Calculation:

Let the length of each side of the cube be A.

According to the concept,

sqrt{3} × A = 8sqrt{3}

⇒ A = 8

Now, the volume of the cube = 8³ = 512 cm³

∴ The volume of the cube is 512 cm³.
